unit_of_analysis: conversation (paired across policies: identical proposals and questions)

metrics.overall_em: exact match over all functional questions (user + friend), averaged over sessions
metrics.user_em: exact match on the user's functional attributes, averaged over sessions
metrics.final_user_em: user exact match after the last session only
metrics.friend_em: exact match on the friend's functional attributes (collateral damage)
metrics.likes_f1: set F1 of the user's many-valued likes
metrics.user_stale: share of user answers that are a previously true value
metrics.user_wrong: share of user answers that were never true for the user
metrics.user_missing: share of user questions with no stored answer
